description: Four ice lanes, each ending at a wall: sprint on bare ice; on bottom trapdoors laid on ice; sprint-jump under a ceiling 2 blocks above the ice; sprint-jump on trapdoors on ice under the same ceiling. Let go and slide after each.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
